answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 24 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the summit solution is checked at the delta gate and logged, the thread audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. That is 38 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
